description: Connections Data - Volumes by Market Segment is a dataset listed in SP Energy Networks open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity network operator, published or maintained by SP Energy Networks. The " Market Segment Data by Volume " data table provides information on the volume of accepted applications made to SPD and SPM over the ED1 and ED2 period. The table gives the following information: Volume of accepted applications across the SPD Licence area, aggregated by Ofgem Metered Market Segments. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Asset Data. Its keywords are ECR, Embedded Capacity Register, SPM, SPD, Connections, Generation. The portal shows 2025-06-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.en). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-spen-open-data-portal.
